name: Bpfasshi
description: The Bpfasshi were a humanoid species associated with the religion the Truthsayers of Bpfassh. In 382 BBY, one member of the species who was a Truthsayer confronted Ran Yaltan for pretending to be a Truthsayer in the Holy City on the moon Jedha. They originated from the Bpfassh system.
